description: Reports which newer HTTP protocols a site advertises: HTTP/3 (h3) and older draft or HTTP/2 alternatives in its Alt-Svc response header, and the Alt-Svc max-age. This is what the server announces, not a TLS ALPN negotiation: the fetch this tool makes cannot choose the protocol, so a site that negotiates but does not send Alt-Svc will show as not advertised. Related tools on this server, for a different need: security_tls_cipher_enum when you need TLS versions a host accepts and its cipher-suite strength; security_vpn_proxy_detector when you need to check an IPv4 address against the public X4BNet list. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_tls_alpn_detector
title: Reports which newer HTTP protocols a site advertises
